sloka: एतदस्यासमं वीर्यं मया राम प्रकीर्तितम् ।कथं तं वालिनं हन्तुं समरे शक्ष्यसे नृप ॥४-११-६८॥।।
transliteration: etadasyāsamaṁ vīryaṁ mayā rāma prakīrtitam ।kathaṁ taṁ vālinaṁ hantuṁ samare śakṣyase nṛpa ॥4-11-68॥।।

translations.english: 'O Rama Vali's strength and fame related by me is unequalled. O king how is it possible for you to kill him in a combat?'
